public_rationale: This sentence is a summing-up judgement that calls on the industry to atone. It makes four claims at once: generative AI was always unsustainable, it relied on 'stealing', its utility was vague, and its ubiquity was overstated. He gives no measure or period for any of them. 'Stealing' is a legal and moral label still being argued in court. 'Vague' and 'overstated' are opinions with no benchmark. Grading it would mean inventing definitions he did not give, so it is not scored.
limitations: Parts of it, such as whether particular training data was used without permission, could be checked separately. But that would not test the sentence as he wrote it.
